parameters.name: Logstore
parameters.description: The name of the Logstore to which log entries are delivered.

parameters.name: Project
parameters.description: The name of the Log Service project that is used for real-time log delivery.

parameters.name: Region
parameters.description: The ID of the region where the Log Service project is deployed.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live create-live-real-time-log-delivery --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --project test_project --logstore test_logstore --biz-region cn-hangzhou --domain-name example.com --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live CreateLiveRealTimeLogDelivery --region cn-hangzhou --Project test_project --DomainName 'example.com' --Logstore test_logstore --Region 'cn-hangzhou' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
